indicates how the track data is to be displayed. By default the entire track is displayed. However, you could display the locations of the start or end of the track or the location where the track reached a specified tracking time. These will be displayed as points.
Limit to current column, row and layer in 2D views:

If this checkbox is checked, only those time series that are in the current layer (top view), current row (front view) or current column (side view) will be displayed. Checking this checkbox helps keep the display from being hard to understand because too many time series are displayed. However, if a DISV model is used, all the cells are treated as being in a single column for the purposes of this check box.
This is the size in pixels at which single points will be displayed. Single points are used for the starting and ending locations and for specified track times.

Specify criteria at starting points to show tracks:
The values entered for the two tables will be used to determine which tracks will be displayed. Only those tracks whose starting points meet the criteria will be displayed.

: If more than one PRP packages are included in the PRT model, a separate PRP number will be assigned to each.
: Release time is the time a particular particle was released.
: Time is the time at which the tracked particle reached a particular location.
: log(Time) is the logarithm of the time at which the tracked particle reached a particular location.
: Status is the status code of the particle. The status codes are as follows:
2: particle terminated at a boundary face
3: particle terminated in a weak sink cell
5: particle terminated in a cell with no exit face
6: particle terminated in a stop zone
7: particle terminated in an inactive cell
8: particle terminated immediately upon attempted release into an inactive cell
9: particle terminated in a subcell with no exit face
10: particle terminated at stop time or end of simulation
: Reason is the reason code for why the particle was recorded. The reason codes are as follows:
4: particle entered a weak sink cell
: Zone is the zone number where the particle is located.
